content.title: 2023 ESC Guidelines for the management of acute coronary syndromes - Task Force Members
content.note: Declarations of interest as reported to the ESC by experts during the yearly call for declaration covering the previous calendar year (calls conducted during development up to and including 2022).

entries.relationship_summary: Any other interest (financial or otherwise) relevant to holding an ESC position. Unpaid member of committees of trials funded by Abbott Vascular (EXCEL trial) and Terumo (MASTER DAPT trial). Mentions clinicaltrials.gov identifiers (EXCEL: NCT01205776; MASTER DAPT: NCT03023020). Involvement described as no active involvement for >3 years for one trial, still listed as original member of statistical executive committee; ongoing active involvement as member of steering group for the other. Mentions Abbott Vascular, Terumo and XIENCE stent in context of trials comparing stents and DAPT durations.

Direct personal payments from healthcare industry: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator/committee member. Companies listed with types of payments: Abbott Medical Japan LLC (consultancy), Life Science Publishing (editorial board fees), Otsuka Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (honoraria), Heartflow Japan G.K. (honoraria), Astellas Pharma (honoraria), Kyowa Hakko Kirin Co., Ltd. (honoraria), Pfizer Japan Inc (honoraria), Boston Scientific Japan Corporation (honoraria), Nippon Boehringer Ingelheim Co., Ltd. (honoraria, consultancy), Kowa Company, Limited (speaker fees). Research funding under direct/personal responsibility: Nipro (Research Grant), W. L. Gore & Associates G.K. (Research Grant), Pfizer R&D Japan G.K. (Research Grant), CMIC HOLDINGS CO., Ltd. (Research Grant).

Direct personal payments from healthcare industry: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator/committee member. Abbott Medical Japan LLC (advisory board fees). Research funding (personal) from healthcare industry: Bayer Yakuhin, Ltd. (contract research expenses).
